_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution. The mutation vocabulary belongs to ONE subset of ONE standard of ONE artifact, so the (non-)oracle registration and the catalog live here. `s.playbook.playbook` is a semio-NATIVE artifact persisted as `.dsl.semio` text and `.pack.semio` binary through this subset's own codecs; no third party reads or writes either, so no oracle is registered — see noOracleDecisions below.

oracles.rationale: A second implementation of the `s.playbook.playbook` parent document and its one parent-lane mutation (`change-title`), in Python, at `../../../../../🧪️tests/🌾️mutate-playbook-1/🐍️.py`, written from `../🧬️schema/📸️snapshot/🔣️.json` and the committed `(before, mutation, after, outcome)` vector; it imports nothing from this repository and transliterates none of its Rust. Steps and blocks are composed content of the `flow` child (`s.stdio.semio@v1/flow`) and are edited only on that child's lane (design §20.15 of ticket 26/09/30/NON-DESTRUCTIVE-HISTORY-EDITING): their mutation vocabulary and oracles are the stdio flow subset's, and the playbook-specific child-leaf builders are pinned by the language-neutral vectors `../../../../../🧫️fixtures/🧫️child-leaves/🔣️.json`, which an independent Python implementation writes and the Rust law folds and undoes. A THIRD-PARTY library was declined, not merely absent: no form or checklist format models a programme whose content is a CHILD ARTIFACT, and none reads this carrier. `package` is deliberately empty: the implementation needs no distribution, so this entry contributes nothing to `🔒️dependencies.json`.

candidatesConsidered.reason: no form or checklist format models a programme whose content is a CHILD ARTIFACT addressed by content, and none of them reads this carrier.
